#!/bin/bash
declare -A functions

# Find all exported function declarations in internal/ (non-test)
while read -r file; do
    while read -r func_name; do
        [ -z "$func_name" ] && continue
        # Count calls to this function
        count=$(grep -r "\\b$func_name(" --include="*.go" | grep -v "_test.go" | wc -l)
        path="${file#/bench/repo/}"
        key="$func_name|$path|$count"
        functions["$key"]=1
    done < <(grep "^func [A-Z]" "$file" | sed 's/(.*//' | sed 's/^func //')
done < <(find /bench/repo/internal -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go")

# Sort by count (third field) descending
for key in "${!functions[@]}"; do
    echo "$key"
done | awk -F'|' '{print $3, $1, $2}' | sort -rn | head -30
EOF

#!/bin/bash

# List of functions we want to check
functions=(
    "DefaultEngine"
    "AppendConditions"
    "GenUUID"
    "ConvertStringToInt32"
    "DefaultAttachmentEngine"
    "IsVersionGreaterThan"
    "GetCurrentVersion"
    "RandomString"

for func in "${functions[@]}"; do
    # Find which file it's declared in
    decl=$(find /bench/repo/internal -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" -exec grep -l "^func.*$func" {} \;)
    if [ -n "$decl" ]; then
        # Count calls
        count=$(grep -r "\\b$func(" --include="*.go" | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v "proto/gen" | wc -l)
        # Subtract 1 for the declaration itself
        actual_count=$((count - 1))
        printf "%d\t%s\t%s\n" "$actual_count" "$func" "$decl"
    fi
done | sort -rn
EOF
